name: Dan O. Popa
title: Professor; Vogt Endowed Chair in Advanced Manufacturing; Director of LARRI
department: Electrical and Computer Engineering; Louisville Automation and Robotics Research Institute (LARRI)
fitReason: Strong applied AI/HRI fit for learned robot dynamics, online tactile calibration and safe human-guided manipulation. The current university-led work is substantially computational as well as physical, making software, model evaluation or tactile-control projects plausible research topics if the mentor agrees.

physicalEvidence.summary: The full July 19, 2026 Electronics paper implements an inner joint-space neural-network dynamics compensator and an outer ARMA(4,4) tactile mapping learned by recursive least squares on a real six-DoF Neuromeka Indy7. Four end-effector piezoresistive sensors drive planar motion; 28 participants generated 112 calibration sequences, then guided a figure-eight trajectory. The tactile update runs at 100 Hz, and learned outer-loop coefficients are retained for runtime rather than continuously adapted through every trial. NAC feedback gains remain fixed across participant trials; the formulation separately describes online neural dynamics weights. The paper assigns Popa conceptualization, methodology, resources, supervision and funding, and current official LARRI personnel include its first-author doctoral researcher and coauthor Jordan Dowdy. This is actual current local learned physical execution, limited to guided planar moderate-speed tasks; it does not establish absolute force estimation, 3D manipulation or autonomous task learning.

shortVisit.summary: The current official profile, NGS laboratory site/contact page and LARRI research/student pages establish an active university group, but no applicable outside-master short-visit or summer 2027 invitation was verified. Local graduate membership, summer independent-study teaching and the university intern mechanism are not treated as offers.

Patient-contact/clinical work and other activities are restricted under the published intern guidance. A proposed bench, software or nonclinical robotics project must be approved. No remote-from-abroad route is implied.

The 2026 human study reports practice-related path-tracking improvement, but a same-user ablation against fixed calibration or competing controllers remains future work. Participant data are restricted by the study’s ethics and consent provisions.

name: Yash Chitalia
title: Assistant Professor
department: Mechanical Engineering; Healthcare Robotics and Telesurgery Laboratory
fitReason: Concrete CS fit in learned visual recognition, segmentation, pose estimation and robot-system integration for healthcare logistics. Focus the inquiry on the AI perception-to-manipulation pipeline; the lab’s separate continuum-robot mechanical/model-based projects are not all machine-learning projects.

physicalEvidence.summary: The lab’s 2026 Autonomous Instrument Tray Assembly project and full paper integrate YOLO12 detection, a part-aware ResNet-18 classification architecture, SAM masks and PCA orientation estimates with a real six-DoF Stäubli TX2-60L and a dual electromagnetic gripper. A technician inspects and presents instruments; the robot sorts and packs them with linear point-to-point motion and a deterministic rule-based packing algorithm. The dataset has 31 instrument classes and 6,975 images; the pictured assembled tray contains 20 different instruments. Transport-style vibration and tilt evaluations each compare three tray configurations over five trials. These are physical packing/contact tests, not clinical sterilization efficacy or a surgeon/technician usability trial, which remains future work. The current lab research page directly owns the project and lists first author Raghav Sankaranarayanan as a postdoctoral alumnus. The perception models are learned; packing and low-level trajectories are not learned policies.

shortVisit.summary: The current HeaRT site establishes active PhD, master’s-alumni and undergraduate research plus surgical collaborators. No primary current page checked provides an external-master short-visit invitation. The retired personal site offers an old PhD opening only; an outside undergraduate in the roster is not evidence of master’s summer access.

scoreReasons.fit: Direct learned perception feeding real manipulation, with substantial classical packing/control explicitly separated.
scoreReasons.physical: Current lab-owned physical instrument assembly and transport-style evaluation in the full primary paper.
scoreReasons.freshness: Current 2026 paper, accepted conference listing and live lab sources.
